from_node.description: Heidegger calls Gestell a danger because it threatens to reduce revealing to ordering and standing-reserve, while also locating a possible saving opening within the ambiguity of revealing.

to_node.description: Heidegger's technology analysis is therefore simply a moral demonization of machines, devices and technological artifacts as evil objects.

bridge.statement: The text explicitly says the dangerous is not technology as such and frames danger/saving at the level of revealing.

ge4.alternative_disclosure: other revealing is not eliminated in principle; the text explicitly preserves the possibility of another relation
ge4.discriminator: distinguish critique of revealing-mode from moral judgment of artifact classes
ge4.revision_trigger: passages that unequivocally identify machines themselves as the evil/danger rather than the ordering mode
